question: Is practical use sufficient when an experience amounts only to delight of the self?
premises: Practical use is proposed as a measure.
An experience may consist only in delight of the self.
The sufficiency of that measure is questioned.
inference: Practical use may extend only so far, even to what is merely delight of the self.
uncertainties: The compound yadātmāhlādamātrakam is read as describing the scope of vyavahāra.
plain_english: To that extent there may be practical use, or it may be only a matter of the self's delight.
